name: pill-dialog
title: Pill Dialog
description: A confirm dialog whose answers are glossy 3D capsules, a blue pill that cancels and a red pill that confirms: they lift on hover and focus, and the chosen one grows while the other fades as the dialog closes. UI SDK's AlertDialog underneath, with an async confirm, and data-agent-confirm on the red pill.

[data-slot=\"pill-dialog-pill\"].transition: opacity var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard), scale var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard)

[data-slot=\"pill-dialog-capsule\"]::bef.transition: scale var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard), opacity var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard)

[data-slot=\"pill-dialog-shell\"].background: radial-gradient(ellipse 22% 26% at 20% 26%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.95), transparent 70%), linear-gradient( 180deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.5), rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12) 24%, transparent 46%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.18) 78%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.42) ), radial-gradient(ellipse 70% 60% at 50% 70%, var(--pill-light), transparent 75%), linear-gradient( 90deg, var(--pill-dark), var(--pill) 18%, var(--pill) 49.4%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--pill), black 30%) 49.6% 50.4%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--pill), white 10%) 50.6%, var(--pill) 82%, var(--pill-dark) )
[data-slot=\"pill-dialog-shell\"].box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55), inset 0 -3px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--pill-light), transparent 40%), inset 0 -1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 6px 14px -4px var(--pill-glow)
[data-slot=\"pill-dialog-shell\"].transition: translate var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard), rotate var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard), scale 300ms var(--ease-standard), box-shadow var(--transition-duration-panel) var(--ease-standard)

[data-pill]:hover [data-slot=\"pill-dial.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55), inset 0 -3px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--pill-light), transparent 40%), inset 0 -1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 14px 22px -6px var(--pill-glow)

[data-pill]:focus-visible [data-slot=\"p.box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55), inset 0 -3px 5px color-mix(in oklab, var(--pill-light), transparent 40%), inset 0 -1px 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.35), 0 14px 22px -6px var(--pill-glow)

docs: `<PillDialog trigger title description confirmLabel agentConfirm onConfirm labels>`, the API of `ConfirmDialog`: a returned Promise keeps it open and pending (a spinner in the red pill's label), a rejection shows its message (`renderError`), `triggerDisabled` and `triggerPending` stop the trigger, and `open`, `onOpenChange`, `controller` and `pendingAnnouncement` pass to the AlertDialog. `labels={{ cancel }}` names the blue pill, "Cancel" by default. Escape, the focus trap and focus return behave as in any alert dialog, and opening focuses the blue pill. `agentConfirm` is required: it becomes the red pill's `data-agent-confirm`, so an agent's press waits for a person through `allow`. The pills' colours are the item's `css`; the dialog follows the theme.
